rideSafetyRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-001 Ride Safety
Brake input cuts motor torque
before the wheel keeps driving.

rangeRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-002 Range
>= 60 km PAS-1 range on a
500 Wh pack.

assistLimitRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-003 Assist Limit
Cut assist at 25 km/h for
the certified class.

chargeSafetyRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-004 Charge Safety
Stop on over-temp, over-voltage,
or charger disconnect.

brakeOverrideRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-010 Brake Override
Inhibit motor within 50 ms of
either brake lever.

structuralRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-030 Structure
Frame carries rider, cargo, and
battery loads without yield.

displayRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-020 Display
Show speed, assist, and remaining
range on the bar display.

batteryCutoffRequirement.label:
«requirement»
REQ-E-011 Battery Cutoff
Open the pack contactor before
any cell exceeds its limit.
